justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/DeferredFileOutputStream.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/DeferredFileOutputStreamTest.java. The nested Builder is small: it extends AbstractStreamBuilder, stores only five fields (threshold, outputFile, prefix, suffix, directory), and its get() just returns new DeferredFileOutputStream(this); the other methods are simple setters. Repo-wide references to DeferredFileOutputStream.builder() are limited to 11 hits, all in DeferredFileOutputStreamTest.java except one self-referential example in the class javadoc, so there is no evidence of high fan-in or high fan-out for the Builder.
